description: This source file defines a final class ErrorOutcome implementing the MappingOutcome interface within the package org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.mappingoutcome. It encapsulates error details related to message mapping, including an error exception, topic path, external message, and a mapper identifier. It provides an accept method for visitor pattern implementation.

classes.name: ErrorOutcome
classes.description: A final class representing an error outcome during message mapping, encapsulating error details and supporting visitor pattern operations.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing the Visitor interface, invoking its onError method with the stored error details.
